integrity.arithmetic_basis: The proof reduces the coefficient series modulo four and treats the all-odd and single-even degree patterns separately.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 1205.6447 lists version 1 on 2012-05-29.
integrity.geometric_formula_basis: For a smooth complete intersection, the ordinary tangent bundle agrees with the virtual tangent bundle obtained by subtracting the normal bundle; Gauss-Bonnet then gives the coefficient formula.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The arXiv record for 1205.6447 lists MSC 14C17 and is classified under Algebraic Geometry.

scientific_limitations: Only the residue modulo four, equivalently the zero and one layers of the two-adic valuation, is classified; higher two-adic valuations are not determined.
The theorem assumes a smooth complex projective complete intersection with all linear factors omitted.
Older Euler-characteristic literature may contain an equivalent congruence under a different formulation; not every historical full text was searchable.
title: A complete mod-four law for Euler characteristics of smooth complete intersections
